Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the accelerator support — LaunchSpark has been using the credits to run early experiments and we are seeing decent traction. Two asks from our side as we plan the next phase:

1) A short extension on the free credits window (30-60 days) — we have a funding close that will push some consumption later than expected.
2) Flexibility to convert a portion of the unused credits into a committed Dedicated discount or a one-time top-up credit if we decide to move to Reserved capacity before the accelerator credits fully expire.

I've attached a brief usage summary (LaunchSpark_Usage_Summary.csv) so you can see how we've consumed the pilot credits and what the forecast looks like.

Can we get a sense of whether Redwood would consider either: (a) a 45-day extension plus the option to convert up to 40% of remaining credits into a pre-paid dedicated discount, or (b) a smaller one-time top-up if conversion isn't possible? We want to avoid a cliff where all remaining credits disappear while we finalize procurement.

Happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Best,

Eve — thanks for the context. Proposed commercial options below (leaning toward option B as easiest from an ops/accounting perspective):

Option A — Conversion to committed discount (preferred if they sign):
- Convert up to 40% of remaining accelerator credits into a prepaid committed credit applied against a 12-month Reserved capacity contract.
- Economics: we treat the converted amount as prepaid ARR for recognition; we can offer an incremental ~20% effective discount on list Dedicated rates for the first 6 months of usage covered by the converted amount.
- Minimums: customer must commit to 12 months at a minimum committed spend of $8k/month.
- Approvals: Finance sign-off required for prepaid recognition + Revenue Ops for bucket treatment. Legal needs to include payment + non-refundability clause.

Option B — One-time top-up + extension (faster):
- 45-day extension of accelerator credits expiration.
- One-time top-up credit equal to 25% of remaining credits (applied as account credit).
- If customer converts to Reserved within 90 days, we apply an additional conversion bonus credit of $5k.
- Approvals: < $10k credit can be approved by Sales Lead; > $10k requires Rev Dir approval.

Recommendation: start with Option B in writing (fast), and include a short-term conversion bonus to incentivize sign. If they signal commit, move to Option A and bake prepaid into the contract.

Attached: deal_term_sheet_v1.pdf (proposed term sheet and approval flow).

Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
